notes: Synthetic slot numbers 0-5 and non-numeric, row-1 positions at and away from 100/120, both player modes, and slot count, type, armament and skill arrays covering every branch. Callees are redirected by 5-byte JMPs to loggers; 0xa78bc logs its first two name bytes (the digit buffer holds stale stack bytes after the NUL) and returns a widget slot chosen by the first name character, so the row shifts land in compared RAM. parse_int and the digit conversion run as original.
